fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. Motorized platoons provide the CCAF with faster-moving infantry that can reposition between garrison posts or screen advancing forces along road networks. Their motorcycle and light vehicle transports sacrifice protection for speed, making them best suited to patrol and rapid-response roles. Flamer sections carry man-portable incendiary weapons that are devastating in close quarters and against fortified positions, though the short range and hazardous fuel supply make flamer duty one of the most dangerous assignments in the platoon.
